title: Claude binary path for FDA

# Claude binary — Full Disk Access

Add EITHER of these to System Settings → Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access (macOS follows the symlink, so either works):

**Symlink (easier to type):**

    /opt/homebrew/bin/claude

**Real executable:**

    /opt/homebrew/lib/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/bin/claude.exe

## Steps

1. System Settings → Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access
2. Click the **+** button
3. In the Finder picker, press **Shift-Cmd-G**
4. Paste one of the paths above and press Return
5. Select the file and click Open
6. Toggle it ON

No restart needed — this session should regain Documents access immediately.
